description: Emily helps existing Emily account holders review their rules, automations, recent activity, contacts, memories, saved-file metadata and usage, and ask their assistant to research, draft, send email, manage calendars or update supported Emily data. Consequential actions are prepared and shown to the user before execution, and billing, subscription and account-deletion operations stay on Emily's website.

defaultPrompt: What has Emily done for me in the last seven days?
Review my calendar for next week and suggest suitable 30-minute meeting times.
Improve this email draft, but do not send it: Hi, just checking whether tomorrow still works.
